title: Throttle HUD
summary: Optional flight instrument using the shared HUD lifecycle.

blocks.text: Use this optional instrument definition through ui.view-hud@1.0.0 with view.flight-hud-state@1.0.0. Every seat follows the same create/rebind/resize/update/dispose path. The read-only flight adapter supplies detached quantities, cached geometry and local preferences. Commands recheck current target ownership and suppression through the adapter. Removing the definition releases gestures, controls and subscriptions; physics, vehicles, split screen and cameras remain independent.
